ios.desc:
Turn any recipe into a clean, cookable card in seconds. Import from websites, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, or photos — no more cluttered blogs, scattered bookmarks, or lost screenshots.

SAVE RECIPES FROM ANYWHERE
• Paste any recipe URL and instantly get a clean card
• Import from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Pinterest
• Scan recipes from photos, cookbooks, or handwritten notes
• AI extracts ingredients, instructions, and nutrition automatically

ONE ORGANIZED LIBRARY
• All your recipes in one place — finally
• Create custom cookbooks to organize your collection
• Smart cookbooks auto-sort by Favorites, Quick & Easy, and more
• Search and filter to find exactly what you need

COOK WITH CONFIDENCE
• Step-by-step Cook Mode keeps your screen on
• See which ingredients you need for each step
• Scale servings up or down with one tap
• Convert between metric and imperial units

SMART SHOPPING LIST
• Import ingredients from any recipe instantly
• Auto-categorizes items by grocery aisle
• Merge duplicates intelligently
• Links back to source recipes

DISCOVER NEW FAVORITES
• Browse curated recipe collections
• Generate recipe ideas from ingredients you have
• See what's popular with other home cooks

WHY HOME COOKS LOVE COOKPAL
• No ads interrupting your cooking
• No life stories before every recipe
• Works offline once recipes are saved
• Syncs across all your devices

Download CookPal and finally organize your recipe chaos.

CookPal Pro unlocks unlimited recipe imports and AI recipe generation. Subscription options available.

quotes.text:
Hi HN

I built CookPal to solve a small but annoying problem for myself: I kept saving recipes from websites, TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram, but never actually used them because they were messy, ad-heavy, and hard to follow while cooking.

CookPal lets you import recipes from:

Any recipe website (URL parsing)

TikTok / Instagram / YouTube links

Photos of recipes or screenshots

Manual text input

It turns them into clean, distraction-free recipe cards with features like Cook Mode, ingredient scaling by servings, and a simple shopping list.

This is an iOS app built with React Native (Expo) + a lightweight backend for parsing. It’s still early, and I’d love any feedback on UX, parsing accuracy, or missing features you’d personally want.

App Store link:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cookpal-recipe-organizer/id6757517561

Happy to answer any questions about the tech or product decisions.
